Official current Source Epoch/ABI + frozen 51/29 verification without re-freeze
E0 zero-write #377 acceptance scope independently adopted before label transition
Native blocked_by official live read: no open blocker; #211 closed/cancelled is NOT Task PASS

precheck: official current issue updated_at, labels, state, exact repository/Issue
native blocked_by and absent unauthorized Claim/FSW
accepted current Pack/source/Host effect lease and fence
read state again immediately before one authorized PATCH
contract.write: exactly ONE authorized GitHub label/state update; no second PATCH after timeout or lost ACK
contract.postread: re-read same official issue + updated_at + native dependencies + source and fence; successful readback alone grants no Claim or Outcome
contract.githubAtomicity: No GitHub label update is transactionally atomic with Host CAS; ABA and concurrent actor race must return UNKNOWN_PENDING_RECONCILIATION

NEG GitHub ABA between preflight and PATCH remains UNKNOWN
NEG lost ACK single PATCH only, reconciliation separate
NEG concurrent issuers / claim collision / changed source
NEG ready readback never authorizes FSW or Task Outcome
